svg.aria-label: Tech stack. DATA: Spark, Flink, Kafka, Redpanda, ClickHouse, Airflow, Databricks, Iceberg, Neo4j, MongoDB, Cassandra. SECURITY: Wireshark, Wazuh, Suricata, OWASP, Burp Suite, Nmap, Vault, MITRE ATT&CK. CLOUD: Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Terraform, BigQuery, S3, Cloudflare, MinIO. CODE: Python, SQL, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, Bash, Godot, Scala, Pydantic.
